dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about the Amenoma Art...

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Among the swordsmiths in Inazuma, some speak of the Raiden Gokaden.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: It is said that in ancient times, a ronin passed the process of forging down to five of his disciples. Each of the five different techniques has its own secrets.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Amenoma Art is one of them.
